operads/tests/integration/test_agent_to_: Complete three-fixture DAG tests reviewed. A five-node diamond has four expected scheduling layers; cycle, orphan and explicitly coloured edge negatives exercise finite graph predicates. Named agents and release operations are node labels, not called implementations or publication authority. The large positive fixture omits explicit colour maps, so no explicit colour compatibility is established there. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_anchored_: Complete anchored-ledger recovery and CLI tests reviewed. Public hardcoded development keys, temporary SQLite files and local child processes test duplicate/conflicting events, forged/wrong-key tips, tail truncation, missing pins, signed-intent recovery after os._exit, hardlinks and sidecar aliases. These are meaningful finite custody controls under filesystem/key assumptions, not proof against all concurrent attacks. ROOT uses parents[3], resolving to operads rather than repository root for subprocess module discovery; CLI/native dependency execution was not attempted. No private key file was read.
operads/tests/integration/test_asgi_mult: Complete ASGI concurrent compile tests reviewed. Five headers named X-Tenant-ID receive successful catalogue responses, but no assertion establishes separate tenant storage, authorization or data isolation. Eight same-key requests are expected to share a catalogue ID. Fixture authors only .agents paths and passes them to the canonical compiler, so current canonical-source compatibility needs validation before calling this a working end-to-end suite. In-process HTTP transport only; not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_benchmark: Complete benchmark source reviewed. It sends 120 in-process requests in batches of 30, mixing catalogue compilation, expected license refusals and structural workflow validation, then checks coarse RPS/p95/tracemalloc ceilings. This measures neither native operation execution nor model-agent throughput; absolute peak memory is used rather than the measured starting baseline. Fixture uses undeclared .agents skill files without current catalogue projection setup. No performance run or fresh metrics obtained.
operads/tests/integration/test_catalog_c: Complete persisted-composition tests reviewed. Five separate colour/schema/validator boundary mutations must refuse after SQLite reopen and exact restoration recover; missing legacy composition payload remains empty without rewriting original JSON. These are finite typed-boundary and persistence checks, not composition equality or execution authority. Unadmitted lifecycle is explicit. No tests run.
operads/tests/integration/test_cli_front: Complete CLI tests reviewed. StringIO captures success/failure JSON and argparse exit 2 with Unicode fixture source, but no CP1252 TextIOWrapper or console encoding is exercised despite the module title. Legacy .agents documents lack canonical declared catalogue setup, so fixture assumptions may no longer reach intended parse checks. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_dual_read: Complete legacy reader test reviewed. It requires nonempty current on-disk documents/operations and checks only the first operation remains Unadmitted. This bounds migration status, not parity of every document, losslessness or executable semantics. Default estate read was not executed.
operads/tests/integration/test_concurren: Complete ten-worker WAL tests reviewed. Distinct writes assert catalogue/event/outbox/idempotency counts; same-key races retry cached responses and assert one idempotency row plus conflicting-digest refusal. The latter does not assert total event/outbox counts, and neither fixture establishes arbitrary process-crash or exactly-once external effects. Operations carry caller-supplied admission and digest metadata. No stress test run.
operads/tests/integration/test_e2e_schem: Complete three-document migration test reviewed. It asserts migrated output begins with raw_bytes.rstrip(), then exact parser leaf reconstruction of the migrated bytes; stripping original trailing whitespace means this is not an exact original-byte preservation assertion. Later persistence checks count operations and compare catalogue IDs/digests without comparing all serialized fields. Legacy .agents fixture lacks canonical declaration setup. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_e2e_full_: Complete six-stage fixture reviewed. It combines two authored declarations, structural DAG scheduling, projection signing, callback outbox delivery and CLI verification using a public fixture key. No operation executor or mathematical checker is invoked; a self-signed envelope validates consistency under one supplied key. .agents-only fixture construction predates the canonical catalogue boundary. No actual full lifecycle or signing run performed.
operads/tests/integration/test_e2e_multi: Complete multi-stage fixture reviewed. Declared audit/proof operations and one slot substitution are compiled, projected, stored and queried; licensed term request correctly expects refusal. Complete Object Fidelity at the final stage checks only selected operation IDs, one output colour and residual_status, leaving leaf nodes, operands and other serializer fields untested. Admission/verified strings are fixture metadata, not actual proof checking. .agents-only setup and absent declared catalogue are compatibility limits; not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_goo_migra: Complete manifest and migration tests reviewed. They pin 41 mappings, check a divergent fourth mirror, require nonempty capability slices and verify generated declarations remain Unbound/Unchecked/Unadmitted/unknown. REPO_ROOT parents[3] resolves to operads, a likely stale current-estate path; a matching byte hash would establish custody, not semantic equivalence or admission. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_higher_op: Complete finite cycle/slot tests reviewed. Actual cycle lengths are 2 through 8, not the introductory 2 through 10; handler returns Ok with invalid DTO rather than the introduction's Err code. One out-of-range slot is checked. These are useful bounded graph/type conditions but not higher-operad coherence laws or all cyclic graphs. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_legacy_ad: Complete typed-retirement tests reviewed. Missing and nominal real estate arguments both must return RUNTIME_RETIRED before reading; all retired term entry points refuse. This is a useful negative boundary, not a substitute current executable kernel. The nominal REPO_ROOT is stale but intentionally irrelevant to the no-read retired path. Not run.
operads/tests/integration/test_higher_op: Complete adapter test body reviewed. It checks explicit exact typed boundary fields, negative/boolean/out-of-range/duplicate slots, positive slot controls and unbound licensing refusal. One test explicitly invokes RustSymbolGameHost to compare optional retirement metadata and reject contradictory admission; this is native coverage source only, excluded from execution. The finite boundary matrix is not a proof of general higher-operad coherence, equivariance or semantics. No tests run.
